title: Optimal Account Balancing
summary: Given an array of transactions where each transaction shows one person giving money to another, return the least number of transactions needed to clear all debts.
statement: Given an array of transactions where each transaction shows one person giving money to another, return the least number of transactions needed to clear all debts.
constraints: Only final net balances matter; return the fewest settlement transfers.
hints: Collapse the history into one net balance per person.
Choose the first unsettled balance and pair it with each opposite-signed later balance.
Apply the transfer in place, recurse, undo it, and keep the minimum; skip duplicate partner balances.
Every solution must settle the first nonzero person with someone of the opposite sign, so the branches are exhaustive.
editorial: Every solution must settle the first nonzero person with someone of the opposite sign, so the branches are exhaustive.
